label: WTI
definition: The WTI crude price, the crude marker of MPC's Mid-Continent crack spread.

label: MEH
definition: The MEH crude price, the crude marker of MPC's Gulf Coast crack spread.

label: ANS
definition: The ANS crude price, the crude marker of MPC's West Coast crack spread.

label: USGC CBOB
definition: The USGC CBOB gasoline price, a benchmark price in MPC's marketing areas.

label: USGC ULSD
definition: The USGC ULSD price, a benchmark price in MPC's marketing areas.

label: Chicago CBOB
definition: The Chicago CBOB gasoline price, a benchmark price in MPC's marketing areas.

label: Chicago ULSD
definition: The Chicago ULSD price, a benchmark price in MPC's marketing areas.

label: LA CARBOB
definition: The Los Angeles CARBOB gasoline price, a benchmark price in MPC's marketing areas.

label: LA CARB Diesel
definition: The Los Angeles CARB diesel price, a benchmark price in MPC's marketing areas.

label: NYMEX WTI Crude Oil futures (CL)
definition: The NYMEX WTI Crude Oil futures contract, the crude leg of the NYMEX 3:2:1 crack spread.

label: NYMEX RBOB Gasoline futures (RB)
definition: The NYMEX RBOB Gasoline futures contract, a gasoline leg of the NYMEX 3:2:1 crack spread. MPC does not use RBOB in its benchmarks.

label: NYMEX NY Harbor ULSD futures (HO)
definition: The NYMEX NY Harbor ULSD futures contract (ticker HO), the diesel leg of the NYMEX 3:2:1 crack spread. MPC Economics' definition calls this leg NYMEX Heating Oil.

label: WTI crude input (MPR 747)
definition: The crude input of MPC Economics' Chicago and Group 3 crack series, both named WTI cracks.

label: Chicago CBOB input (MPR 16475)
definition: The gasoline input of MPC Economics' Chicago crack series.

label: Chicago ULSD input (MPR 16477)
definition: The diesel input of MPC Economics' Chicago crack series.

label: MEH crude input (MPR 14133)
definition: The crude input of MPC Economics' Gulf Coast crack series, named an MEH crack.

label: Gulf Coast CBOB input (MPR 11926)
definition: The gasoline input of MPC Economics' Gulf Coast crack series.

label: Gulf Coast ULSD input (MPR 12838)
definition: The diesel input of MPC Economics' Gulf Coast crack series.

label: Group 3 CBOB input (MPR 13076)
definition: The gasoline input of MPC Economics' Group 3 crack series.

label: Group 3 ULSD input (MPR 9408)
definition: The diesel input of MPC Economics' Group 3 crack series.

label: ANS crude input (MPR 4055)
definition: The crude input of MPC Economics' LA crack series, named an ANS crack.

label: LA gasoline input (MPR 9660)
definition: The gasoline input of MPC Economics' LA crack series (the CBOB column of the definition's input table).

label: LA ULSD input (MPR 9657)
definition: The diesel input of MPC Economics' LA crack series.

label: RVO cost (MPR 13056)
definition: The Renewable Volume Obligation cost per gallon, the same input in every region; an Ex-RVO series deducts it from each product barrel.
